'''Hobi Rann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who ran a shop known as [[Hobi Rann's Fine Imported Goods]]<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''The Jewel of Yavin'' took place while Lando Calrissian was Baron Administrator of Cloud City, a period which started in 1 ABY and ended in 3 ABY according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The shop was located on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor in the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], which floated in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Rann sold cheap and [[Color/Legends|colorful]] goods imported from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hobi Rann appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The character is listed as a merchant that players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
